propositions: Mutating CLI verbs that are silent on success (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, set-file-impact) are indistinguishable from idempotent no-ops, causing agents to run follow-up 'rebar show' reads to verify writes and misinterpret silent success as failure.

Every in-scope mutation verb must emit exactly one stdout confirmation line on successful write using the uniform contract '<past-tense-verb> <args-summary>', and 'no change: <reason>' for idempotent no-ops, built from CLI args and seam outcome with zero follow-up store reads.

Global --quiet and --output json flags must be extracted at the top-level router before partition dispatch to apply uniformly to all verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves, with quiet suppressing only confirmation text and --output json replacing confirmations with a uniform JSON envelope.

Existing REDIRECT record emission (link write/no-op) and consumed seam returns (add_dependency dict|None) must be preserved byte-identical; the REDIRECT record counts as the sole stdout result and never receives an additional confirmation line.

Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must be normalized to the shared message contract preserving all information they currently emit, with transition's UNBLOCKED ids preserved in the normalized line.
Confirmations print to stdout with logs on stderr; exit codes and core seam return contracts remain unchanged; --quiet never suppresses REDIRECT records only the text confirmation channel.
